translations.web: I will no more speak much with you, for the prince of the world comes, and he has nothing in me.
translations.bsb: I will not speak with you much longer, for the prince of this world is coming, and he has no claim on Me.
translations.kjv: Hereafter I will not talk much with you: for the prince of this world cometh, and hath nothing in me.
